title: nervilia purpurea
intro: Nervilia purpurea, commonly known as the Purple Nervilia or Nervilia, is a terrestrial orchid species that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Nervilia purpurea include wound healing, anti-arthritic, and anti-ulcerative activities, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy of Nervilia purpurea's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may contribute to its reported health benefits.
